retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, sepia-toned close-up portrait with a soft-focus background and right-aligned, two-tone serif typography.
triggerTerms: sepia high contrast portrait with cyan text

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate portrait of a person in profile or three-quarter view, rendered in a warm sepia or duotone palette with deep shadows. The subject is positioned on the left, looking downward or away, while the right side features a blurred, atmospheric background and stacked, elegant serif typography in a contrasting cool color.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via depth of field
Warm sepia image vs. cool cyan typography
Asymmetrical balance between subject mass and text block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled as a close-up headshot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the highlights on the nose and cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows their downward gaze, then moves to the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame acts as active negative space, filled with soft bokeh and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep brown and sepia tones for the photographic image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream or off-white for the highlights and background glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted cyan or teal for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the subject's face.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, cream, and one accent hue

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stress in the larger display type
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Italicized script-like serif paired with a bold, condensed all-caps serif.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo block in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and vertical stress match the display type.
Elegant, traditional feel for the subtitle lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia-toned portrait of a person in profile, looking down, with a very shallow depth of field creating a warm, glowing bokeh background on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned cyan text in the upper right quadrant. Use a light serif italic for the first two lines and a bold condensed all-caps serif for the main name, stacked closely.

verificationChecks: Is the image sepia-toned with high contrast?
Is the text right-aligned and cyan?
Does the typography use a mix of italics and all-caps serifs?

mustRedesign: Original artist name and specific logos
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for grain consistency across the image
Ensure text legibility against the bokeh
Verify the sepia tone isn't overly yellow or red
Confirm the right-alignment of all text elements
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast sepia portrait + right-aligned cyan serif typography + soft bokeh background.
